items.title: EU ministers in Ireland tackle Israeli settlement trade and Ukraine defence
items.description: EU ministers in Ireland have announced a mission to support Lebanon’s army but remain divided on sanctions on Israel.

items.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
items.description: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia's asymmetric war of attrition
items.description: Kyiv and Moscow have stepped up attacks on each other's infrastructure in recent weeks, aiming to weaken the opposing economy and undermine morale. Ukraine has paid a heavier price because it does not possess ballistic missiles and finds it increasingly difficult to intercept those targeting its territory.

items.title: Ukrainian War Documentary ‘Brace For Oblivion’ Wins in Ireland, Comes to Kyiv
items.description: Filmed over nearly four years on Ukraine’s front lines, Xackery Irving’s documentary “Brace For Oblivion” follows seven civilians who became soldiers after Russia’s full-scale invasion. After winning an international award in Galway, the film returns to Ukraine for a special screening in Kyiv.

items.description: As the conflict in the Persian Gulf continues to impact and shape the region, journalists from RFE/RL's Central Newsroom and Iranian service, Radio Farda, deliver ongoing updates and analysis.

items.title: As US steps up pressure on Iran, ordinary people say they’re paying the price
items.description: Iran’s economy was in ruins even before the war, and before U.S. President Donald Trump’s latest “D-Day” sanctions. So far, ordinary Iranians are bearing the brunt and feeling apathetic, meaning surviving leaders, for now, might face a lower risk of an uprising.

items.title: Iran fuel crisis deepens amid war and sanctions
items.description: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze supplies.

items.title: Why the Middle East Oil Shock Failed to Save Russia’s Budget
items.description: Six months into the U.S.-Iran war, Russia’s oil windfall looks surprisingly meager despite initial predictions of a revenue boom.

items.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
items.description: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday.
